landing.badge: DOU Tlemcen • Direction des Œuvres Universitaires
landing.hero_desc: Welcome to RÉSIVO, the official dormitory management system of Cité Universitaire Tlemcen. Register your student card ID, verify admissions status in real time, view your assigned residential room, and submit maintenance dispatches.
landing.steps_desc: Follow the four simple steps from matriculation to settling into your assigned dormitory room.
landing.step_1_desc: Submit your student card ID, academic faculty, and personal details via the online intake form.
landing.step_2_desc: Housing officers cross-reference your record with official admission lists and allocate an available room.
landing.step_3_desc: View your allocated block and room number on the student portal, then collect your key at the housing bureau.
landing.step_4_desc: Once you have moved in, the portal stays with you: report a fault, request a room transfer, or update your contact details.
landing.services_desc: Everything you need to manage your campus living arrangements in one secure place.
landing.service_status_desc: Follow your dossier from submission to decision, and read the reason recorded by housing officers when an application is not approved.
landing.service_room_desc: Allocations are automatically cross-referenced with official university admission rosters. Residential blocks are designated with strict capacity limits.
landing.service_maintenance_desc: Report plumbing, electricity, carpentry, or other issues directly through your dashboard with fault photos. Track triage and repair status in real-time.
landing.service_transfers_desc: Active residents may apply for room transfers based on block preferences and academic justifications, reviewed directly by housing officers.
landing.footer_desc: Official university accommodation system for enrolled students. Providing secure housing, streamlined room allocations, and 24/7 facility maintenance services in Tlemcen.
landing.footer_institution: Direction des Œuvres Universitaires (DOU) • Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche Scientifique
landing.footer_rights: © {year} Cité Universitaire Tlemcen. All rights reserved.
